dedupe_keys.name: bafin analysis of ict incidents reported under dora in 2025 germany

description: The German financial supervisor's first analysis of major ICT incidents reported under the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act. The BaFin page says that since 17 January 2025 financial firms must report major ICT incidents under Article 19 of DORA; in 2025 they reported 733 incidents, which count as 478 independent incidents, and about 60 cross-cutting incidents at third parties, such as ICT or payment service providers, led to 315 reports, so about half of incidents came from third parties. It names complex IT systems, geopolitical conflict and concentration and critical dependencies as the main risk drivers and says attacks were rarely successful. The analysis is free to read online with charts. Coverage is financial firms supervised by BaFin. Caveats: figures depend on reporting thresholds in the first year. For simulation it shows how outages at shared service providers cascade to many banks at once. A related catalogue record is the OCC cybersecurity and financial system resilience material.
